body.title: Make the test sweep finish reliably without --test-force-exit
body.reproduction: On Node v24.21.0, run `npx tsx --test 'src/workflow/**/*.test.ts' 'src/mcp/**/*.test.ts'` several times. Expected: every run finishes in about 5.5 s with 0 failures. Observed: in about 1 of 6 runs (1 of 6 observed on 2026-10-08; those run logs were kept outside the repo and are not committed), src/workflow/artifacts/companion/__tests__/render.test.ts never finishes. It runs until an external 300 s timeout and is reported as failed with 'Promise resolution is still pending but the event loop has already resolved' (2013 tests, 2011 pass, the file counted as a failure). The full sweep `npx tsx --test 'src/**/__tests__/*.test.ts'` also hangs, and did so at commit c8fb4ed3 as well. render.test.ts does NOT hang alone (25 of 25 runs pass in about 0.2 s), with the other companion test files (104 of 104 pass), or as 32 concurrent copies of itself.
body.rootCause: Not yet diagnosed; establishing it is the first part of this fix. What is established: the file's three tests call renderErCompanion (src/workflow/artifacts/companion/render.ts), which goes through assembleShell (src/docgen/render/shell.ts). For these small diagrams that path only reads the bundled runtime assets with fs/promises readFile and spawns no subprocess, so the file has no obvious long-running handle of its own. The file's own header already recommends running it with --test-force-exit. The hang reproduces only inside the full parallel run, so the trigger is likely shared state or resource contention across test files, or the test runner under load, rather than this file in isolation. Using --test-force-exit is not a fix: it ends the run without showing that every file finished. A minimal reproduction on Node v24.21.0 (one test returning a promise that never settles) hung until killed both with and without the flag and printed no 'still pending' message, so how the runner reports this case still has to be established as part of the diagnosis.
body.fixIntent: Find what leaves a test promise unsettled when render.test.ts runs inside the full parallel sweep, and correct it, so that both the workflow+mcp subsets and the full sweep finish reliably on every run, without --test-force-exit and without dropping any file from the results.
